name: St William of York, Great Lever

boundary.description: From the junction of Hight Street and Brigdeman Steet, NE along Bridgeman Street to the railway. S along the railway to the point opposite Ashby Close. By a beeline to Lower Doe Hey Reservoir (exluding Ashby Close), W along the middle of Lower and Higher Doe Hey Reservoir and Doe Hey Brook to Slack Fold Lane and by a beeline to and N along Smethurst Lane, Sapling Road, Moors Green Lane, Ellesmere Road then by a beeline to Adelaide Street and Bridgeman Street its junction with High Street.
